objective: Make the remaining owner Vision acceptance gate measurable by attaching one to three fixed owner-selected scene categories to each rating, reporting aggregate category coverage only, and requiring a provisional diversity target in addition to 20 rated images and an 85 percent weighted score.
non_goals: Do not auto-classify scenes with a model or infer tags from image pixels, summaries, prompts or filenames.
Do not persist pixels, summaries, per-observation QA records, scene tags or aggregate QA status across runtime restart.
Do not auto-promote Vision, change the confidence threshold, enable decision support or waive owner acceptance.
Do not change the Vision provider, model, prompt, context, scheduler, VRAM reservation or capture lifecycle.
Do not run a real model, Cloud request, desktop capture, GPU benchmark, repeated workflow or soak test.
Do not open M09 before the owner completes and accepts the real varied-scene QA run.
contracts: Each review requires one to three unique tags from the fixed allowlist gameplay, menu_hud, chat_text, desktop_ui, motion_effects and dark_occluded.
Renderer input cannot introduce arbitrary tags, duplicate tags, an empty tag list or more than three tags.
The in-memory ledger stores only fixed tags beside existing bounded metadata and exposes aggregate per-tag counts, never observation IDs, summaries, pixels, prompts or filenames in status.
A scene category counts as covered only after at least two rated samples use that tag; provisional diversity requires at least four covered categories.
candidateTargetMet requires at least 20 rated samples, weighted score at least 85 percent and the provisional diversity target; promotionApproved remains false.
Rerating replaces both rating and tags without increasing the sample count; profile reset removes their aggregate contribution.
The Perception page remains presentation and typed intent only; App.vue retains typed IPC and error ownership.
allowed_dependencies: Python and JavaScript standard libraries, Vue already installed in the workspace, and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger tests prove category counts, rerating replacement, profile isolation, fixed-tag validation and the combined 20-image/85-percent/four-category candidate rule.
Core route tests prove the exact sceneTags field is required and arbitrary or malformed tags fail closed.
Desktop control-client tests prove one-to-three unique allowlisted tags are validated before loopback network I/O.
Dashboard visibly asks the owner to classify every rated image and reports category counts, covered-category progress and the combined candidate status in plain Vietnamese.
Perception, route and desktop tests plus desktop typecheck/build and repository fast tests pass.
Module-brief validation, GitNexus change scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S31-owner-scene-diversity-qa-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/perception/tests -p "test_*.py"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s apps/core-runtime/tests -p "test_perception_routes.py"
